messages:
ana: quick alert 1: ran gemma-lite-v2 through our int4 pipeline for chat evals — seeing fluent english but massive regressions on french/pt tests and weird name mangling (function names truncated). fp16->int4 drop BLEU fr: 31.0 -> 19.7, en stable.

kai: interesting. same tokenizer? any rotary fiddles?

ana: tokenizer same (byte-nfkc), converter: awq headwise + our default embed-proj reorder. i also saw systematic embedding vector offsets in the first 32 dims when comparing fp16 vs int4.

ren: embedding offset + language-specific drop points to either tokenizer id remap OR embed projection row permutation. can you diff embedding matrices for first 10 tokens (common words)?

ana: did that. sample diff: token "le" emb fp16[0:8] ~ [0.012, -0.004, ...], int4 ~ [-0.200, 0.110, ...] (large sign flip in low dims). but token ids matched.

yara: sign flip suggests a byte-order / endianness interpretation mismatch when we pack quant blocks. did the converter change the dtype order or use a different 'proj_order' flag?

ana: converter logs: "writing embed_proj with order=colmajor" but the model card expects rowmajor (family notes). suspicious.

quant-bot: queued job 60221 for headwise embed-diff check (subset=lang-smoke).

ana: reproducer:
```
rwd-convert --src gemma-lite-v2/fp16.chkpt --dst gemma-lite-v2-awq.quant \
  --method awq --headwise-quant true --embed-proj-order colmajor --calib-samples 1024

rwd-infer --model gemma-lite-v2-awq.quant --task chat --lang fr --prompt-file tests/fr/smoke.txt \
  --tokenizer byte-nfkc --rotary_freq_mul 1.0 --max-tokens 512
```

kai: try two quick probes: A) force embed-proj-order=rowmajor at convert, B) keep colmajor but flip byte-endian on load (swapbytes) to see if sign flips recover. also sweep rotary_freq_mul [0.85, 1.0, 1.15]  fractional headwise scaling can amplify small projection errors.

ren: added: check per-head rotary frequency multipliers. some families use fractional freq per head (freq_mul per head) and int4 noise can push high-frequency heads into aliasing.

deploy-bot: job 60221 started (node=gpu-a3), est 6m

[6m later]

ana: quick results (200 ex subset):
- orig int4 (colmajor) rotary=1.0 => FR-BLEU 19.7, name-mangle rate 23%, ppl 34.2, p50 48ms
- int4 (rowmajor) rotary=1.0 => FR-BLEU 28.4, name-mangle rate 5%, ppl 13.8, p50 51ms
- int4 (colmajor + swapbytes) rotary=1.0 => FR-BLEU 27.9, name-mangle 6%, ppl 14.1
- int4 (rowmajor + rotary_freq_mul headwise sweep 0.85) => FR-BLEU 29.0, ppl 12.9, p50 52ms
- fp16 baseline => FR-BLEU 31.0, ppl 11.0, p50 84ms

yara: solid signal. primary culprit was embed-proj ordering/endianness packing bug. secondary effect is rotary frequency sensitivity on high-frequency heads  tuning rotary_freq_mul recovered the rest.

kai: action items: 1) patch converter default to preserve model's embed_proj_order (don't default to colmajor), 2) add a quick binary swapbytes probe in conversion sanity checks if projection checksums mismatch, 3) include per-head rotary_freq_mul recommendation in model artifact if calibration prefers non-1.0.

ren: also adding a token-level smoke diff that picks 500 canonical multilingual tokens and fails conversion if embedding cosine sim < 0.85 median.

quant-bot: job 60221 completed 1: artifacts: gemma-lite-v2-awq-v2.quant (embed_order fixed) uploaded.

ana: opening PR with tests + note to onboarding checklist: "preserve embed_proj_order + verify endian/csums; rotary_freq sweep for int4". tagging @kai @yara.

yara: +1. we'll also add a short note to the model card: recommended convert flags: --embed-proj-order rowmajor --rotary_freq_mul 0.85 for best FR translation under int4.

kai: nice triage. putting a follow-up on eng-ml sync to consider adding per-head freq metadata to artifacts for future automated calibs.

ana: thanks all, saved calibration artifacts and headwise rotary plots in the model repo.
